verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip with a PyTorch/DeepSpeed/vLLM software stack. Registrable outbound HTTP event webhooks are a SaaS/API-platform capability outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence suggests Gaudi ships such a feature. The probes found no OpenAPI or API surface that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
